verifiedProgress.technicalAndProductMemory: Bun + compiled CLI + real MCP stdio: 10 persisted summaries/resources across six levels; unchanged repeat made zero additional contract-model calls; no-source and snapshot freshness verified. Technical file dossiers now include recognized source/configuration without extracted symbols.
verifiedProgress.incrementalParsing: Synthetic 1002-file/1000-symbol fixture: scan 222 ms, refresh 145 ms with one modified file parsed and 999 reused (SCIP disabled). Working-tree repeats, renames, deletes and atomic snapshot rollback covered.
limits: Real-model audit, hierarchy/product generation and architectural answers pass finite fixtures and prescribed fact reviews; general semantic accuracy is not established. SDK totals include formatting retries, cached input and auxiliary work, not subscription invoices.

Impact and trace use stored static references. Score weights are versioned heuristics; unrecorded external effects, concurrency, authorization and reversibility are not guessed. Trace does not prove runtime feasibility or data flow and does not enumerate longer alternative paths.

HTTP/multi-repository acceptance passes with the official SDK and compiled CLI using protocol 2025-11-25. The historical 61.152% token reduction run had possible evaluation-artifact contamination. Latest clean prepared-module corroboration has 16.325% fewer query tokens but 43.527% higher SDK estimated query cost, excluding preparation. These finite measurements do not establish general savings. One HTTP bearer token permits access to all served repositories.
Manual metrics updates require analyze/audit to regenerate prior interpretations; the metrics command itself only measures/imports.
No whole-roadmap completion claim is justified.
verifiedProgress.retrieval: Pinned Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B + BGE reranker on TEI 1.9.3 and Qdrant 1.19.0: 8/8 Spanish/English queries rank 1 over 28 English functions. Full SQLite source rebuild without mounted checkout, five knowledge kinds, filters, physical purge and repository isolation verified.
verifiedProgress.vectorIncrementality: 34 initial embeddings; identical repeat 0 new / 34 reused / 0 payload updates; one changed body and one deletion: 1 new / 30 reused / 30 payload updates, unchanged vectors byte-for-byte equal.
verifiedProgress.validation: Current checkpoint: 177 tests across 43 files; lint, Rslint, TypeScript and compiled CLI/MCP build pass. A fresh empty-directory frozen-lockfile installation also passes these gates and compiled CLI help/doctor checks (benchmarks/clean-install-acceptance.json). Checks do not stop, restart or recreate containers. Real local model acceptances are historical separate runs; no new inference, WLT refresh or hosted CI run claimed for this checkpoint.
verifiedProgress.hierarchicalIncrementality: Real SCIP chain with configurable depth: one body edit parses one file, refreshes affected technical/product ancestors and preserves unrelated cards; unchanged repeat makes zero calls. Coordinate-only symbol moves rebind evidence without leaf calls, while prose containing absolute lines conservatively regenerates. Actual generative fixture: 19 initial measured calls, 10 after changing price, unrelated local format card reused, product flags the 18%/20% discrepancy; deterministic refresh 327 ms, changed generation 389398 ms.
verifiedProgress.deterministic: SQLite references match the TypeScript language service for 20 functions (imports, direct calls, callbacks and Unicode columns). Real RepoLead tracked working-tree inventory: 110 files, 413 symbols, 253 export bindings, 80 tests; exact source hashes verified. MCP pagination and compiled doctor diagnostics pass. Untracked implementation files are not part of this Git-tracked inventory.
verifiedProgress.quality: Builtin AST LOC/complexity/nesting/empty handlers and distinct observed graph metrics now persist during scan. Real jscpd 5.4.2, Ruff 0.17.3 and Radon 6.0.1 run against captured SQLite source; 134 metrics and 3 tool issues in the fixture, normalized LCOV 2/3 line and 1/2 branch coverage, three report cache hits and zero additional contract-model/judge calls on repeat. Compiled metrics CLI and real MCP stdio deliver the measurements.
verifiedProgress.policyQuality: Actual authenticated Claude Code judge: 16/16 prescribed positive/counterexample cases across eight policies, 224209 input / 7788 output SDK tokens, 1.372743 USD estimated cost (not a subscription invoice), zero new calls on repeat. Twelve policies registered; explicit public type-contract evidence and nonrecursive multi-module cycle witnesses implemented.
verifiedProgress.httpMcp: Compiled CLI with two repositories and two simultaneous official SDK clients: 20 resources read, product/technical context, overlapping subject ID disambiguation, no-source, persisted documents, live refresh and regenerated memory verified. Protocol 2025-11-25, localhost default, explicit browser origin allowlist, required bearer token and 1 MiB body limit.
verifiedProgress.changeAnalysis: impact_analysis/impact and trace_flow/trace are integrated in MCP and CLI without generative calls. Actual SCIP fixture verifies two paths from an imported HTTP handler to persistOrder, reference-only callbacks excluded from flow, six affected symbols, public/private member classification, one linked test and source-checked synthetic LCOV. Every hop maps to a stored relation; compiled CLI and no-source MCP observe endpoint replacement after refresh.
verifiedProgress.prioritization: Versioned hotspot factors and uncertainty ranges, test-path exclusion, module scoping, pagination and source-bound coverage. Snapshot-bound opportunities derive from confirmed findings and hotspots, preserve file/module evidence and legacy entries, cache unchanged inputs, and withhold stale projections. Actual six-commit Git/SCIP fixture: score 31.98 before verified synthetic coverage and 59.03 with prescribed uncovered lines, automatic scan/quality/audit publication, one contract judge call with zero repeat calls, Node CLI and nine MCP calls; no mutation execution or business-effort inference.
verifiedProgress.generative: Real Claude Haiku + local Qwen: 29 measured calls (19 initial, 10 after a body edit), 726657 remote SDK tokens and 1762 local tokens including retries; zero additional calls on unchanged repeat. Initial generation 633560 ms, deterministic refresh 327 ms, changed generation 389398 ms. Updated product explicitly flags the 18%/20% discrepancy. Counts include cached input/auxiliary SDK work, not subscription billing.

reviewNotes: The audit inferred likely triviality from one symbol without source behavior in its candidate evidence. This smoke run validates routing, schema and caching, not the semantic correctness of that rejection.

completionRule: Una capacidad solo se completa con implementación integrada y evidencia de aceptación. Los servicios opcionales deben tener adaptadores utilizables y pruebas de contrato; no se simulan resultados de herramientas ausentes.

Twelve versioned weighted factors expose points, provenance status and uncertainty range; caller facts are labeled, missing factors never become zero risk, and workflow remains provisional. Tests cover typed storage/event effects, relevant tests, public/private contracts, schema exposure, source-bound/unknown coverage, limits, pagination, multi-repository resolution and no-source. benchmarks/change-analysis-acceptance.json verifies the full SCIP/compiled CLI/MCP path, six impacted symbols, a linked test and checksummed synthetic LCOV. requirements.requirement: trace_flow desde endpoint hasta side effects con evidencia
requirements.acceptance: BFS con ciclos, múltiples rutas, límites explícitos y procedencia; sin inventar edges
requirements.evidence: MCP trace_flow and CLI trace perform bounded BFS over CALLS and recorded effect edges, with shortest-path witnesses, per-hop analyzer/location proof and separate depth/node/edge/path limits. Tests cover cycles, both branches, duplicate analyzer provenance, reference-only callbacks, ambiguous/unknown targets, current snapshot and no-source. Real SCIP acceptance traces an imported Express handler alias through two service branches and OrderRepository.save to persistOrder; every hop is checked against SQLite. Endpoint argument ranges resolve imported bindings and do not confuse shadowed parameters with same-name module functions. Explicit targets may name known sink functions; automatic effect mode consumes typed stored effects and does not infer arbitrary external API semantics. Runtime feasibility, longer alternate paths and Joern data flow are not claimed.

requirements.requirement: Criterios de éxito, documentación actualizada y evaluación de calidad/token savings
requirements.acceptance: scan 1–2k archivos <10min; refresh 1 archivo <30s; segundo análisis cero calls; preguntas con evidencia y objetivo <10% de tokens medido sin sacrificar corrección
requirements.evidence: Clean installation and 164 tests/41 files pass; scan/refresh timing, zero-call unchanged analysis, real-model technical/product provenance and actual-source MCP answer evaluation are recorded. The 90% reduction target remains unmet: the historical architecture run used 38.848% of baseline tokens (61.152% reduction), with possible evaluation-artifact contamination and no proof of the target. The tiny prepared fixture is more expensive with MCP (56927 vs 26713); preparation totals and failed/preliminary comparisons are preserved. New clean-capture evidence-mode run: 737073 manual vs 724296 MCP tokens, 1.733% raw reduction, rejected for incomplete dependency invalidation explanation; no accepted saving claimed. Latest clean prepared-module corroboration: 66096 manual vs 55306 MCP query tokens (16.325% reduction) with requested facts preserved, but SDK estimated query cost increases 43.527%. Preparation adds 144114 tokens; unchanged repeat makes zero calls. No monetary break-even at observed rates; 90% target remains unmet.
remaining: Demonstrate the roadmap target of less than 10% of equivalent manual tokens while preserving answer correctness; current measurements do not meet it.
